Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075157 (Diacylglycerol kinase gamma). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, join target_dictionary on tid, and join compound_structures on molregno. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
